text: Debugging is an important skill for any programmer. When your code does not work, the first step is identifying bugs. You need to find where the problem is and what causes it. There are many debugging tools that can help you, such as breakpoints and error messages. However, a systematic approach works best. Instead of changing code randomly, check one part at a time. Logging is also very useful. By adding log statements, you can see what your program is doing and where it fails. With patience and good methods, you can solve most bugs step by step.
